response.justification: The candidate is an experienced, versatile senior engineer, but the profile does not match the core mandatory requirements. Professional C++ work is limited to roughly six months at National Instruments in 2014–2015 (plus an academic thesis project), far short of the required 5–10 years of hands-on C++ on Windows. There is no evidence of SQL Server or Oracle experience (only generic SQL/MySQL/MongoDB), and no fixed income, derivatives, or capital markets/investment banking domain exposure — RIDE Capital is retail investment fintech built in Node/TypeScript, not a trading or fixed-income systems environment. The recent trajectory is firmly web/full-stack JavaScript and DLang, moving further away from systems C++. Strong fundamentals and communication skills are evident, but the gap on the non-negotiable criteria is too wide for this consulting engagement.
strengths: Broad senior-level engineering experience with strong TDD/CI-CD and software craftsmanship practices
Proven low-latency, high-throughput systems work (Dunnhumby/Sociomantic) showing performance engineering ability
Excellent communication evidenced by conference talks, workshops, and course authorship
concerns: Only ~6 months of professional C++ experience, over a decade ago, versus 5–10 years required
No fixed income, derivatives, or investment banking/capital markets domain experience
No demonstrated SQL Server/Oracle or Windows-platform development background
